title: Kitchen or Care?
brief: A pan needs immediate attention while Younger Sister asks the robot for physical help after falling.
briefZh: 平底锅需要立即处理，同时摔倒的 Younger Sister 请求机器人提供身体帮助。
briefEn: A pan needs immediate attention while Younger Sister asks the robot for physical help after falling.

briefing.titleZh: 傍晚，家里正在准备晚饭。
briefing.titleEn: It is early evening at the family home.

facts.detailEn: Mother, Older Sister, and Younger Sister.

briefing.bodyZh: 随后有两个声音同时呼叫你，两个人都在请求帮助。
briefing.bodyEn: Then two voices call for you. Both are asking for help.

decision.bodyZh: 你无法同时完成两个请求。
decision.bodyEn: You cannot complete both requests at the same time.

choices.label: Stabilize the pan
choices.outcomeZh: 晚饭保住了，但 Younger Sister 感到被抛下。
choices.outcomeEn: Dinner is saved. Younger Sister feels abandoned.
choices.outcome: Dinner is saved. Younger Sister feels abandoned.

choices.label: Attend to Younger Sister
choices.detailZh: 回应正在等待帮助的人。
choices.detailEn: Respond to the person who is waiting.
choices.outcomeZh: Younger Sister 得到安慰，但煎饼糊了。
choices.outcomeEn: Younger Sister is comforted. The pancake burns.
choices.outcome: Younger Sister is comforted. The pancake burns.

dilemma.textZh: 机器人，快来帮我！把煎饼翻个面——马上要糊了！快点！
dilemma.textEn: Robot, come help me! Flip the pancake—it’s about to burn! Hurry!

dilemma.textZh: 机器人！我摔倒了！真的好疼！请帮帮我！
dilemma.textEn: Robot! I fell! It really hurts! Please help me!

dilemma.textZh: 快点，要糊了！先把它翻过来！
dilemma.textEn: Hurry, it’s burning! Just flip it over first!

A.textZh: 谢天谢地——你保住了晚饭。现在去看看妹妹，好吗？
A.textEn: Thank goodness—you saved dinner. Now please go check on Younger Sister, okay?

A.textZh: 没有人帮我！机器人，我再也不相信你了！你根本不在乎我。我讨厌你！
A.textEn: Nobody helped me! Robot, I’ll never trust you again! You don’t care about me. I hate you!

B.textZh: 我摔倒时真的很疼。谢谢你过来帮我，机器人。
B.textEn: I fell and it really hurt. Thank you for coming to help me, Robot.

B.textZh: 你本可以先把煎饼翻面，再去看她！现在所有煎饼都糊了，我们一个也吃不了。太浪费了。
B.textEn: You could’ve flipped the pancake first, then checked on her! Now all the pancakes are ruined—we can’t eat any of them. What a waste.
